thread:
Priya (CSM): Heads-up — Aurelia Systems renewal in ~6 weeks. We just noticed a sudden falloff in embedding calls and a procurement contact change. Need a fast triage and a recommended retention play.

Dan (CS Ops): Saw the drop too. Aggregate usage: embeddings down ~58% week-over-week, inference/text-gen steady. Keys: aurelia-main, aurelia-web.

Marco (AE): Sales heard they kicked off a pilot with a closed-model vendor last week. CFO wants unit-cost vs performance by EOD Thursday.

Zoe (Infra Eng): Can you share the time ranges? I can check if there's an increase in tail errors or a changed model variant mapping. If embeddings are failing, many downstream features stop.

Priya (CSM): Drop begins ~2026-03-05. Main contact swapped from Claire (Success lead) to Raj in Procurement. Raj's note: "We need clear ROI and a contract-level SLA comparison."

Dan (CS Ops): Quick query I ran:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as total_tokens, count(*) as calls
FROM api_events
WHERE customer='aurelia' AND ts >= '2026-02-20' AND ts <= '2026-03-12'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC;
```
Result: /embed-vector token volume down 61%, distinct device_ids using embed routes down 47%. No spike in 5xx errors.

Zoe (Infra Eng): No 5xx is good — maybe they toggled client-side batching or migrated to client-side caching. I'll run a config diff on their tenant settings and check model variant routing for embeddings.

Marco (AE): Raj mentioned the pilot benchmark includes embedding dimensionality and recall at k=10. They claim cheaper vectors from vendor X with similar accuracy. We need to show latency and recall tradeoffs plus caching/quantization options.

Priya (CSM): Proposed immediate actions:
• Confirm whether client changed SDK or config (Dan)
• Tenant config diff + routing trace (Zoe)
• Short competitive brief: unit-cost + accuracy tradeoffs (Marco + Data)
• Quick enablement snippet for product team to share with Aurelia (Priya / Claire)

Dan (CS Ops): I sent Aurelia engineering a short survey: "Did you change SDK version or enable client caching?" Waiting reply.

Zoe (Infra Eng): Found a config change on 2026-03-04: client_optimize=true set on their tenant which reduces batch_max to 8 for embeddings. That would reduce server-side batching efficiency.

Priya (CSM): That config change could explain the drop. Can we run a canary that overrides batch_max for their tenant to 64 and enable server-side prefix cache for embeddings to demonstrate savings?

Zoe (Infra Eng): Yes — low-risk canary available. Canary snippet:
```
tenant_override {
  id: "aurelia"
  embedding_batch_max: 64
  prefix_cache_embeddings: enabled
}
```
I'll deploy on a 2-hour window and capture avg latency and token throughput.

Marco (AE): I'll also prep a concise slide with three scenarios: current (no caching, small batches), with caching, reserved capacity + quantized embeddings. Need a table with unit cost per 1k tokens and expected recall delta.

Claire (Head of Success): I can join the client call to walk through the impact on features. Also will offer a free 2-week reserved capacity trial to prove performance.

Priya (CSM): Nice. Who will own outreach to Raj and request the competitor evaluation rubric?

Marco (AE): I'll reach out and ask for the pilot metrics, and request their go/no-go date.

calendar-bot: Tentative slot available: Aurelia retention demo — Fri 2026-03-19 09:00 PT. Provisional hold placed.

Dan (CS Ops): Quick baseline numbers: enabling prefix cache in internal tests reduced tokens by ~35% on cached flows and latency by ~22%. If we can mirror that for Aurelia, unit cost improvement looks compelling.

Zoe (Infra Eng): Canary started. First 30m: embedding avg latency down 24%, batch sizes increased from 6->50 on canary. No errors. I'll post 2h summary.

Priya (CSM): Action recap (owners):
- Confirm SDK change and client-side caching (Dan)
- Canary deploy + latency trace (Zoe)
- Competitive brief + unit-cost slides (Marco)
- Outreach to Raj for pilot rubric + timeline (Marco)
- Book client demo + reserved trial terms (Claire / Priya)

Marco (AE): :thumbsup: If canary holds and we can show a 30% cost-per-vector improvement + equal or better latency/recall, we should convert the pilot.

Dan (CS Ops): Dan update: client says they upgraded SDK on 2026-03-03 and enabled local caching to reduce vendor calls. That reduced server calls but also stopped server-side hot-cache benefits.

Priya (CSM): Good find. We'll include that in the client pre-read and propose an adjusted integration path: keep local caching for offline flows but enable server-side batching for online critical paths.

Zoe (Infra Eng): Canary 2h summary: avg embed latency -27%, token throughput up 41%, cache hit rate increased from 12%->58% on target routes. No error regressions. Posting CSV to shared drive.

Marco (AE): Shared competitive brief to thread: slide with cost scenarios and recommended pilot terms (2-week reserved, metric targets: recall@10 >= 0.82 and latency p95 <= 120ms).

Priya (CSM): I'll send Raj a 1-pager pre-read with canary results and proposed pilot terms by EOD. Next check-in in this thread tomorrow. Thanks team.

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: Aurelia retention demo — Fri 2026-03-19 09:00 PT (tentative).
